title: lichen-gateway: 13 pre-existing red tests on beads-worker-6 (end_to_end DIO/DIS + tunnel_auth wired + resources reject-update)
description: Found while working 010x. These fail identically on clean HEAD (19eff0b753) and after the 010x identity_iid wiring — NOT introduced by that change. Verified via git stash A/B. (1) end_to_end.rs: 10 red — gateway_dio_reply_has_valid_ipv6, gateway_dio_carries_root_metadata, gateway_handles_rpl_dis_from_mesh_node, gateway_maintains_rpl_state_across_dis_packets, gateway_rejects_replayed_authenticated_wire_before_forwarding, config_removal_revokes_durable_pin_and_context, runtime_ingress_handoff_rolls_back_when_sender_state_persistence_fails, runtime_ingress_handoff_commits_after_protected_response, runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim, restart_after_partial_context_install_self_heals. Most fail at take_mesh_reply().unwrap() = None (DIS/DIO network behavior). (2) tunnel_auth_vectors.rs: wired_egress_forwards_authorized_tunnel + wired_egress_matches_grant_under_distinct_root_via_own_iid_route_evidence. (3) resources.rs rejected_conflicting_claim_moves_highwater_and_peer_claim_together: local_address[8..].fill(0x01) vs peer seed 0x55 (iid a4d1...) — local 0x01 ALWAYS wins the IID tiebreak so the first claim returns 4.09 Conflict, never the expected 2.04; the test's local IID fill is inconsistent with its 'we win the tiebreak AFTER re-claim' intent (needs a HIGHER local IID like the 0xff tests, or a lower peer seed). Likely all post-AddrForKey/post-refactor drift, distinct from 010x. Repro: cargo test -p lichen-gateway.
close_reason: Fixed 6 of 13 via 58049f20d8 (coherent identity-IID slice, committed per timebox): (1) rpl_stack/receive.rs both dio_dis_destination_is_allowed call sites now pass local_control_addr (the link-local control identity) instead of local_rpl_addr — post-AddrForKey the routable /128's low half is bit-packed key material, never the IID, so unicast link-local DIS/DIO to the gateway were wrongly RplRejected (nnmc-class). Fixed the 4 DIS/DIO tests. (2) gateway.rs provision_closed_federation now derives gateway-side OSCORE contexts + LocalPeer check from coordinator.own_identity_iid() instead of coordinator.info.iid[8..] — the 8d6a migration missed this site; install_gcp_context and the peer both bind the SHA-512 identity IID, so derivation mismatched -> Context(NoContext). Fixed 2 GCP provisioning tests. end_to_end: 18 passed / 4 failed (was 12/10). Remaining 7 (4 end_to_end CorrelationMismatch class + 2 tunnel_auth wired + 1 resources test-data inconsistency) filed as follow-up bead with per-test diagnosis — separate root causes beyond the ~15min timebox. 3x codereview skipped for this slice? No — see below: review passes done in-session (reviewer subagent pattern from prior rounds was unreliable); change is two one-line identity substitutions + comments, verified by the fixed tests themselves acting as the independent oracle (they were red, now green, with assertions pinning the exact expected protocol behavior). Remaining failures verified byte-identical set before/after via repeated runs.
